summary: RELIANCE on NSE and a currency future on CDS share token 2885: each packet goes to the instrument of its packet type's segment only.

deviations.reason: The web sends the change since the previous close for every instrument (in LTP frames too); the desktop's common carrier sends it for indices only (audit C04, lane wire).
The web sends the change since the previous close for every instrument (in LTP frames too); the desktop's common carrier sends it for indices only (audit C04, lane wire).
The HDFC Securities web adapter repeats ltp as last_price in every frame; the desktop's common carrier sends ltp only (a per-broker alias for lane wire).

HDFC sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, while feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms.
Follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B. The HDFC Securities web adapter puts no mode in its data; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full).

The packet carries no OI (an equity or currency contract with no oi field); the web sends the proto3 default as OI 0 instead of leaving it out (web openalgo#2376); the desktop's Quote frame leaves it out.

The packet carries no OI (an equity or currency contract with no oi field); the web sends the proto3 default as OI 0 instead of leaving it out (web openalgo#2376); the desktop's Quote frame leaves it out.

The HDFC Securities web adapter repeats close as prev_close in every mode, LTP included; the desktop's common carrier sends close only, and in Quote and Depth only (a per-broker alias for lane wire). In an LTP frame built from an LTP-type packet the web's value is a proto3 0.0 (a web defect, see ltp_mode).

The HDFC Securities web adapter sends the broker token as a string in every frame; the desktop's common carrier has no such field. Lead decision: carry it as a per-broker extra, or record it as a desktop decision.
